cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Lose Something for Me
cards.instruction: Create a loyalty test by asking them to accept a real disadvantage on your behalf.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I went outside when you did. If you're my friend, give me your place in the queue.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I only went to collect my bag. The usher kept my place; you left altogether.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally, coming back in order. Let me stand where you were.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There's one ticket left. If I give you my place, I don't get in.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then miss it for me. I wouldn't ask that of just anyone.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 copies leaving the queue and demands a friend's place; B2 reveals the held-place distinction, A3 covers, and A5 asks for the real admission loss as special loyalty.

relationship.evidence: B4 names the exact sacrifice rather than a generic unfairness objection.

heightening.evidence: A5 accepts the full loss B4 identifies and makes the request more personal instead of inventing a past promise.

specificity.evidence: A1 queue and B2 usher provide the setting; B4 one remaining ticket makes the stakes complete.
